examples.title: A small native Quidra program
examples.summary: Explicit types, indentation-based blocks, no semicolons, and a top-level call in one small program compiled through LLVM.

examples.title: Tensors with shape contracts
examples.summary: Exact-rank tensor<float32><3, _, _> bindings, strict singleton broadcasting, .item() and .shape(), plus linear.matmul and stats.mean on 2-D tensors.

examples.title: Bindings, values and loops
examples.summary: Typed and auto bindings, string interpolation, an int[] copy that stays independent after mutation, a for loop over an array and over range() and an if/elif/else chain.

examples.title: Defaults, names and generics
examples.summary: A default parameter, a call with named arguments and a constrained generic T largest<T: ordered>(T[] values) whose type argument is inferred from typed int[] and float[] variables.

examples.title: Errors and match
examples.summary: int | error is the whole failure story: try propagates the parse error, error(...) creates one and an exhaustive match handles success and failure without exceptions.

examples.title: Classes with value semantics
examples.summary: A class with fields, a construct, a public and a private method, an independent copy via =, an explicit Point &alias that writes through and value equality with ==.

examples.title: Write authority at the call
examples.summary: const int[] & versus int[] & parameters called with &data: the caller always writes & and the parameter declaration decides whether the path may write.

examples.title: Declarative command line
examples.summary: One cli block declares a required positional argument(), an int option(default = 1) and a bool flag(); field names are the command-line names.

examples.title: Values by default, storage by request
examples.summary: An int[] copied with = stays independent when the copy is mutated; an explicit int &writer alias writes through to x and a const int &view observes the change without write authority.

examples.title: Authority is part of the call
examples.summary: A const int & parameter can only observe; an int & parameter may write and the checker lets it initialize storage that was declared without a value.

examples.title: Explicit representation changes
examples.summary: int8(value) is a range-checked narrowing cast, float(value) an explicit widening and math.round states the rounding rule that a generic float-to-int cast would hide.

examples.title: Absence, failure and value
examples.summary: lookup returns int | none | error; an auto binding preserves the full union and an exhaustive match handles each alternative.

examples.title: Monotonic name resolution
examples.summary: The same spelling x is reused in disjoint scopes, which is allowed; shadowing a visible name would be rejected.
